Boston, fan 1518.52

My deans Sir,

lo you mi

mailed to your address a copy ora Setter to Hon. Vater Couper, d hew York. on the subject ofthe Union → was admised to put lish Ais Letter by some of or leavi new here - Who saw the Manuscraph - so That !½ might he distributed to Shenghen the knion Sentiment $Shall he glao to tenan your viens git = merit- so that it may be made Knoum + scuttereo if calculated to do good - hema with great respect Jaur sen Spiens Hali.. fapen
